annotation.title_clean: ASTM F3196-18 Standard Practice for Seeking Approval for Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) Small Unmanned Aircraft System (sUAS) Operations
annotation.title_en: ASTM F3196-18 Standard Practice for Seeking Approval for Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) Small Unmanned Aircraft System (sUAS) Operations
annotation.venue: ASTM International Book of Standards Vol. 15.09
annotation.summary_en: ASTM F3196-18 is a voluntary standard practice for seeking civil aviation authority approval for beyond-visual-line-of-sight operations of small unmanned aircraft systems under 55 lb. The excerpt is a store page showing scope and shipping information, with the full standard text not shown.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to sUAS seeking BVLOS approval from a civil aviation authority
Default scope: sUA under 55 lb (25 kg) that are remotely piloted
Compliance is a recommended means of seeking approval; regulatory application is at the CAA's discretion
Weight, altitude and airspeed limits are assumed to be set by the CAA
Users must establish their own safety, health and environmental practices
